title: Typeahead Suggestions That Never Wait on the Network
description: The search dialog builds its suggestions locally and paints them as soon as you type. An optional server request can supply a different order for the same shortlist, but it never blocks: it goes out after a typing pause, it is applied only if the same query is still on screen, and a late answer for a query you have typed past is discarded. Orders are cached per query, and the whole path sits behind a flag that is off by default. Type in the box to watch the timing and the staleness rule.
